patches.title: Reject overlong DNS names after compression-pointer expansion
patches.description: Adds the RFC 1035 255-octet expanded wire-name bound to the legacy Focal c-ares 1.15 parser while retaining its existing pointer-hop cap.

dep3.origin: Target-specific adaptation of the upstream CVE-2026-69184 parser fix to Focal's legacy ares_expand_name.c; the existing 50-hop limit is preserved.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact Focal 1.15.0 source accepts an expanded DNS wire name longer than 255 octets; a maximum-valid 255-octet name remains accepted.
tests.patchedExpectation: The installed parser rejects the same overlong name with ARES_EBADNAME and accepts the maximum-valid 255-octet name.

patches.title: Bound DNS name expansion and compression-pointer traversal
patches.description: Backports RFC 1035 expanded wire-name length enforcement and a 1024-pointer parser work bound to Debian Trixie, with compatibility coverage for valid deep chains.

dep3.origin: Backport of the upstream v1.34 fix, with regression tests inserted at the corresponding Trixie test-file location.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact Trixie source accepts the crafted 1100-hop backward pointer chain and returns a parsed record; the 200-hop valid deep-chain control also parses.
tests.patchedExpectation: The parser returns ARES_EBADNAME and no record for the 1100-hop input; a valid 200-hop backward chain and maximum-valid 255-wire-octet name remain accepted, while a 256-octet expanded name is rejected.
